blocks.text: 🪝 NITI Aayog Releases First-Ever 'Investment Friendliness Index (IFI) 2026': Gujarat Ranks #1. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Gujarat tops Large States with 56.6 score; Uttarakhand tops Hilly/NE states.
Large States Ranking: Gujarat #1 (56.6/100), Maharashtra #2 (53.7), Tamil Nadu #3 (53.3).
Category Winners: Uttarakhand #1 among Hilly/NE States; Goa #1 among UTs and City States.
Evaluation Pillars: Assesses 28 states & 8 UTs across 84 indicators spanning 8 pillars (infrastructure, regulatory ease, fiscal health).
Large States 1st rank (Gujarat 56.6) vs Hilly States 1st rank (Uttarakhand) vs UTs 1st rank (Goa).
